subject: Q4 SF activation: cost coding, PO request, and deposit approval
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 SF activation: cost coding, PO request, and deposit approval

Team —

We have a final quote from Brightside for the San Francisco activation (attached). Summary: total event cost $42,300 (venue/staging/city permits/AV + 10% ops buffer). They are requesting a 50% deposit to lock the date ($21,150) and can start vendor bookings once we have a PO or a finance-approved deposit path.

Ask: can finance confirm cost center and GL coding for this spend and provide a PO number we can give Brightside? We also need confirmation on spend cap (this activation was budgeted at $50k but the VP asked for written approval to proceed).

Notes: Venue is October 29–30. This is a customer-facing activation aligned to the SF user summit. Marissa — I’m leaving the logistics to you for vendor sign-off; please confirm there are no additional line items.

Attachments: Brightside_Quote_v3.pdf, Event_Tech_Rider.pdf

Next steps I’ll take after PO: send signed SOW (if required) and remit 50% deposit.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0129

---
Reply chain will include vendor W9 and COI before PO is issued; tagging Mina for any tax/account questions.

Thanks Rishi — quick confirmation: Brightside confirmed the AV package in the quote includes a secondary power run we asked for, and the tech rider shows our on-site needs. I attached a short event brief with the line item checklist. No hidden catering asks beyond the quoted hospitality budget.

I’ll hold on final vendor approvals until PO is in place. If finance needs a separate line for travel reimbursements for 2 external demo specialists, flag it and we’ll split that out.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa@redwood.com

[Attachment: Q4_SF_Event_Brief.pdf]

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 SF activation: cost coding, PO request, and deposit approval

Rishi/Vanessa — I reviewed the quote and provisional budget. Finance can approve this spend under the following conditions: 

- Cost center: 60012 (Field Marketing Events)
- GL account: 543210 (Events - Third Party Services)
- Spend cap: approved up to $45,000 for Q4 activations without C-level sign-off; any spend over $45k requires VP approval. This quote at $42,300 fits within the cap.
- PO requirement: PO is required for any vendor invoice > $5,000. Please submit a PO request via procurement (link below) and include vendor W9 + COI. We will not process the deposit until W9 and COI are on file.

I have generated a provisional PO placeholder id (PO-PENDING-2026-1129) — procurement will convert to a real PO once the vendor paperwork is uploaded. Procurement link: https://redwood.app/procurement/po-request?request_id=2026-1129

Reimbursements: travel for external demo specialists should be coded to cost center 60012 but submitted on an expense report with original receipts; pre-approval required for airfare > $750.

Dev Patel
Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

Quoted from prior: "We will not process the deposit until W9 and COI are on file."

Hi Rishi/Vanessa — thanks for the confirmation. Attached: W9_Brightside.pdf and Certificate_Insurance.pdf. We can accept a 50% deposit invoice; attached is a draft invoice for $21,150 labeled Invoice_Deposit_50pct.pdf.

If you can provide the PO number and billing contact for remittance (AP contact and email), we will issue a final deposit invoice and hold the date. Our payment terms after deposit are net 30 for the remainder.

Let us know if you need any contract redlines — otherwise we will proceed with SOW and deposit invoice on receipt of PO and paperwork.

Thanks,

ops@brightsideevents.com

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Dev, cost center 60012 and GL 543210 are confirmed. Mina — tagging you to route the PO-PENDING-2026-1129 request through procurement and convert to PO-2026-1129 (final). Once procurement has the PO number, please send to Brightside AP (acct@brightsideevents.com) and confirm billing contact: Redwood AP (ap@redwood.com).

Brightside — we received your W9 and COI, thanks. We will provide the official PO by Monday 10/19 and authorize the 50% deposit for $21,150 to secure the venue. Please hold the date pending receipt of the PO and final SOW.

Travel/reimbursements: Vanessa will submit any external demo travel costs separately and follow Dev’s reimbursement guidance.

Next steps checklist:
- Procurement: convert PO-PENDING-2026-1129 -> PO-2026-1129 and notify Brightside (action: Mina/Dev)
- Rishi/Vanessa: sign SOW if no redlines by 10/20
- Brightside: issue final deposit invoice to ap@redwood.com upon PO receipt

Thanks,
Rishi
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
